### 🌌 Knowledge Nexus: Module Contribution

Thank you for contributing a new interactive module to the Knowledge Nexus! Please ensure you have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) guide before submitting.

### 📋 Submission Checklist
To ensure a smooth merge and deployment, please confirm the following:

- [ ] **Static Constraints:** My module relies only on static assets (HTML, CSS, JS, Markdown, media) and requires no server-side compilation or backend logic to run.
- [ ] **Directory Structure:** All my assets are contained within my specific module folder (`modules/[category]/[module-name]/`).
- [ ] **JSON Registry:** I have added my module's metadata to `data/modules.json` ensuring the link points accurately to my `index.html` or main file.
- [ ] **Theme Adherence:** I have included Knowledge Nexus's shared CSS (`css/module-shared.css` or similar global styles) to maintain the platform's visual standard.
- [ ] **Local Testing:** I have run a local server and verified that the module opens correctly from the main Knowledge Nexus interface without errors.
